findings.title: Fighter model beats ratings alone
findings.text: Every UFC fight from 2012 to 2026 (6,997), each year predicted by a model trained only on earlier years: Locksmith picked 63.4% of winners (log loss 0.638) vs 55.8% for an Elo rating (0.680). It reads striking and grappling rates adjusted for each opponent, durability (knockdowns absorbed, KO losses), age, reach, layoff, weight changes, rating uncertainty and each fighter's betting-market history from earlier fights (how the market rated him and how he did against those prices).

findings.title: How the fight ends
findings.text: The method model (KO/TKO, submission or decision for either fighter) beats the base rates (log loss 1.630 vs 1.705); 'goes the distance' 0.674 vs 0.693.

findings.title: Style matchups didn't add anything
findings.text: Explicit matchup features (one fighter's knockdown power against the other's chin, takedowns against takedown defence, submission threat against control time, finishing rate against KO losses) made both the win model and the method model slightly worse in walk-forward tests, so they are not used. The model already learns these from each fighter's rates.

findings.title: The betting line is sharper on its own, but Locksmith adds to the opener
findings.text: On 6,645 fights with odds, the opening line scored 0.624 (log loss), the closing line 0.605, Locksmith alone 0.636. Blended with the opener (weights fitted on earlier years only) Locksmith scores 0.614 vs the opener's 0.623; the line then moved toward Locksmith 59% of the time.

findings.title: Locksmith's picks: the opening line
findings.text: Betting the side Locksmith likes at the opening price (rules chosen each year from earlier years only) went 1668-855 for +248.6 units (+9.9%). The same bets at the closing price returned +2.0%, so a UFC pick is only shown while today's price is still the opener or better.

findings.title: Betting on fight day doesn't pay
findings.text: Locksmith blended with the closing line and bet at the closing price: 1080-592, +2.0%. By fight night the line already knows what Locksmith knows.
